# awscc_wisdom_content (Resource)

Definition of AWS::Wisdom::Content Resource Type



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `knowledge_base_id` (String) The identifier of the knowledge base.
- `name` (String) The name of the content.

### Optional

- `metadata` (Map of String) A key/value map to store attributes without affecting tagging or recommendations.
- `override_link_out_uri` (String) The URI you want to use for the article.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags used to organize, track, or control access for this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `title` (String) The title of the content.
- `upload_id` (String) A pointer to the uploaded asset. This value is returned by StartContentUpload.

### Read-Only

- `content_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the content.
- `content_id` (String) The identifier of the content.
- `content_type` (String) The media type of the content.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `knowledge_base_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the knowledge base.
- `link_out_uri` (String) The URI of the content.
- `revision_id` (String) The identifier of the content revision.
- `status` (String) The status of the content.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wisdom_content.example
  identity = {
    content_arn = "content_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `content_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the content

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wisdom_content.example
  id = "content_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_wisdom_content.example "content_arn"
```
